_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 58 (Bruh Skyleader): three more Suggested-merges upgrades off your Algebra screenshot. (1) The worklist now groups by the OBVIOUS keyword — 'Algebra 1-2, Semester 1' / 'Elementary Algebra, Part 1' / 'Algebra 3-4' all land in ONE Algebra family (we now fold structural divider words like Part / Semester / Level, on top of the level grouping). The big families (ASL, the languages, ballet, piano, cosmetology, ESL) all consolidate; Linear/College/Pre-Algebra correctly stay separate. (2) When you pick a course from 'Merge into a different existing course,' its title now fills the Proposed-title box and you can CLEAN IT UP before folding in. (3) A new 'Completion note' box lets you stamp a merge with something like 'both parts must be completed for full credit' — it shows as a ⚑ note chip + in the course's ⓘ details. Every merge is still your one-click Confirm. Hard-refresh to see it. Next engineering lever (measured first): the member-join Jaccard.
